query: SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ar.valorLiquido, ar.vencimentoData, ar.formaCobranca FROM accounts_receivable ar LEFT JOIN collection_actions ca ON ca.receivableId = ar.id WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < '2026-05-11T00:00:00' AND ca.id IS NULL AND ar.formaCobranca LIKE '%Cheque%' ORDER BY ar.cliente;
